about.section_subtitle: I don't just write code; I engineer unbreakable business growth engines.
about.p1: Across 30+ large-scale software systems built across 8 distinct industries, my focus has consistently been at the exact intersection of architectural rigor and tangible commercial ROI. Whether architecting a multi-GDS flight and hotel aggregator engine, or developing an AI-driven government procurement platform with predictive machine learning models, I analyze the entire operational picture before committing a single line of code.
about.p2: My approach is deeply rooted in Systems Thinking and Clean Architecture. I believe a winning platform is an interconnected ecosystem built from the ground up to handle extreme concurrency peaks, protect data integrity, and provide frictionless user experiences.
about.p3: When you partner with me, you are not hiring a typical developer; you gain a strategic technical partner who orchestrates the system from initial architectural blueprints, through optimal technology selection, to production deployment and live monitoring.

faq.section_subtitle: Transparent answers regarding development process, pricing models, and technical execution.
faq.q1: What is the cost of building a custom enterprise system or package?
faq.a1: Costs depend on scope and architectural complexity. Productized packages start from 20,000 SAR up to 80,000 SAR with guaranteed deliverables. For custom enterprise platforms, we provide a full architectural blueprint and fixed estimate during a free 30-minute consultation.
faq.q2: Is the system 100% production-ready upon handover?
faq.a2: Absolutely. All systems are delivered production-ready with comprehensive architectural documentation, CI/CD pipelines configured, server hardening, and staff onboarding for administrative dashboards.
faq.q3: What post-launch warranty and maintenance do you offer?
faq.a3: Every package includes 1 full month of complimentary post-launch support and bug fixes. Ongoing monthly architecture retainers and SLA maintenance contracts are available for scaling systems.
faq.q4: Do you handle full-stack architecture end-to-end?
faq.a4: Yes. As a Systems Architect, I design and construct the entire ecosystem: from robust database schemas and high-throughput backend APIs (.NET, Python, Laravel) to modern reactive frontends and mobile apps (React 19, Next.js, Flutter).
faq.q5: Can AI and custom RAG pipelines be integrated into existing legacy databases?
faq.a5: Definitely. I specialize in embedding RAG engines and multi-LLM orchestrators into existing enterprise relational databases and document archives with strict security, zero data leakage, and hallucination prevention.
faq.q6: How do we get started working together?
faq.a6: Our process is simple and transparent: (1) Book a free 30-minute strategy call, (2) Receive an architectural scope proposal and pricing, (3) Sign the agreement and initiate agile bi-weekly development sprints with live staging progress.
